definitions.explanation: Showing courage and spirited determination, often with a bold or heroic quality.

examples.japanese: {勇|いさ}ましい{姿|すがた}だった。
{兵士|へいし}たちは{勇|いさ}ましく{戦|たたか}った。
{太鼓|たいこ}の{勇|いさ}ましい{音|おと}が{祭|まつ}りの{会場|かいじょう}に{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}った。
examples.english: The stirring sound of drums echoed throughout the festival grounds.

notes:
Often describes people, actions, or sounds that evoke a spirited, bold, or heroic impression. Can also describe sounds like drums or marches that feel rousing and energetic.

CONJUGATION:
・{勇|いさ}ましくない (negative)
・{勇|いさ}ましく (adverbial form)
・{勇|いさ}ましかった (past)
・{勇|いさ}ましさ (noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{勇|いさ}ましい{姿|すがた} (brave/gallant figure)
・{勇|いさ}ましい{声|こえ} (bold voice)
・{勇|いさ}ましく{立|た}ち{向|む}かう (stand up bravely against)
